about_page.p: Your trusted partner for packaging and baking supply needs in Pati, Central Java.
about_page.about_title: Pinus Packindo — The Most Complete Packaging & Baking Supply in Pantura
about_page.about_p1: Pinus Packindo is a distribution and retail company specializing in food & beverage packaging, as well as baking materials and equipment. Located at Jalan Penjawi No. 11, Pati, Central Java, we have served thousands of businesses across the Pantura region.
about_page.about_p2: With years of experience and a dedicated team, we are committed to delivering high-quality products, friendly service, and competitive prices directly from producers. From home businesses to industrial scale, Pinus Packindo is ready to be your trusted partner.
about_page.about_p3: We believe packaging is more than just wrapping — it is the face of your product. That is why we always offer the most complete selection so your business looks professional and memorable to your customers.
about_page.vm_sub: The direction and goals that guide us in serving customers and building a sustainable business.
